title: Cron Job Specification
description: Schema for specifying a Vercel Cron job to be implemented by Agente04_DevBackend. Enforces guardCron() as first call, syncLog() in finally, and idempotency requirements.

job_name.description: Kebab-case job name. Used as the syncLog job field and must match the vercel.json cron key.

route_path.description: File path for the cron route handler. Must be inside app/api/cron/.

job_logic_path.description: File path for the job's business logic function. Must be inside lib/jobs/.

schedule.description: Cron expression for the job schedule (standard 5-field cron syntax).

guard_cron_first.description: MUST be true. guardCron(req) must be the absolute first call in the cron route handler.

idempotency_mechanism.description: The mechanism used to ensure the job is idempotent (safe to run multiple times with the same result). 'upsert' uses prisma.model.upsert(); 'existence-check' checks if record exists before creating; 'version-flag' stores a processedAt timestamp; 'external-deduplication' uses the external service's idempotency key.

sync_log_required.description: MUST be true. syncLog() must be called in the finally block of the cron route.

tracked_counts.description: Names of count fields to track in the syncLog counts object.

max_duration_seconds.description: Expected maximum duration in seconds. Vercel Cron timeout is 60s for Hobby / 300s for Pro.

error_handling.description: How the job handles errors during processing: 'log-and-continue' processes remaining items; 'log-and-fail' stops on first error; 'partial-success' returns status 'partial' if some items fail.

vercel_cron_config.description: The vercel.json cron entry for this job.

path.description: The HTTP path Vercel calls to trigger the job.

schedule.description: Cron expression (same as the schedule field above).
